build_roi_heads: build ROIHeads from a detectron2 config and input shape using the ROI_HEADS_REGISTRY
select_foreground_proposals: select foreground proposals from a list of Instances by filtering out background and ignore labels
select_proposals_with_visible_keypoints: filter proposals to keep only those with at least one visible keypoint inside the box
review_Res5ROIHeads_forward: review the Res5ROIHeads forward method that pools features through res5 and predicts boxes and masks
review_CustomStandardROIHeads_forward: review the CustomStandardROIHeads forward method that independently processes box, mask, and keypoint heads with optional droploss
